bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/ (retained views, Stack, Form, ScrollView), springboard/ui/src/ (stack, table, collection, sidebar, constraint)
summary: BifrOSt has an imperative, retained-view toolkit with stacks (including first and last text baseline alignment), grids, forms, group boxes, control groups, tab views, scroll views with a bound scroll position, source lists, tables, a button style protocol and animation, plus Auto Layout style constraints with baseline anchors. It has no declarative View protocol, modifier chain or state-driven body.

features.note: retained imperative views, no declarative body or modifier chain

Environment values with scoped overrides, typed reads and a with_value modifier for one subtree work and are tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-32.rs. Gap: the model is not wired into the shell or apps, and views still take their properties on each view instead of reading a generic modifier chain; the lab machine is needed only to confirm a shell view reads the environment on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/button_style.rs (ButtonStyle, ButtonConfiguration, ButtonRole, Bordered, BorderedProminent, Borderless, Plain, LinkStyle), springboard/sdk/src/view/controls.rs (Button::styled, with_role), springboard/sdk/src/view/forms.rs (ProgressStyle)
features.note: Built 2026-10-24: a button style protocol. ButtonStyle draws and sizes a Button from its ButtonConfiguration (label, isPressed, role, enabled, focus, frame), so apps restyle buttons or write their own style; built-ins Bordered (default, unchanged look), BorderedProminent, Borderless, Plain and LinkStyle, and ButtonRole Destructive/Cancel (destructive draws in DESTRUCTIVE). Host tests in springboard/sdk/src/view/tests_groupings.rs (a_custom_style_sizes_and_draws_the_button_from_its_configuration, the_built_in_styles_ask_for_less_room_as_their_bezel_shrinks). Gap: only buttons have a style protocol (no ToggleStyle, LabelStyle, PickerStyle, GroupBoxStyle or custom ControlGroupStyle bodies), no glass or accessory-bar button styles, not yet verified on Midget. REA ev_ed0948f3d1cbfc813ba01d8632df27a86ec8079573d60b20e31314657d0c2be9.

springs and timing curves exist; Window::animate animates frame, opacity and background for any change made inside it (headless_swatch_is_drawn_where_the_animation_has_moved_it, headless_underdamped_spring_passes_its_target_then_rests_on_it in springboard/sdk/src/view/animation.rs); animation is opt-in per closure, not tied to state changes; no matchedGeometry
text fields and text layout; no Text formatting views or TextEditor parity checked
Symbol glyphs draw headless into an offscreen surface (springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10-w7.rs); no AsyncImage or Image resizing modifiers
toggle, stepper, progress, picker; fewer than SwiftUI's set (no DatePicker/ColorPicker views checked)
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. menu model exists; no Commands builder

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 15 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no Shape protocol or Path trim/stroke API for apps
glass/vibrancy materials in renderer; no blur, shadow, mask modifiers or Canvas for apps

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/stack.rs (stack, distribute, grid, adaptive_columns, overlay, first_fitting); springboard/ui/src/lazy_stack.rs (visible_rows, visible_items, content_height: the lazy list and grid windows)
features.note: Stack and grid layout as pure functions: HStack/VStack spacing and flexible items, the four fixed distributions, adaptive columns, grid, a ZStack-style overlay and a ViewThatFits-style first_fitting. The SDK Stack view arranges its children with stack and distribute. Lazy list and grid windows (the rows or items under a viewport, with overscan) are tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-33.rs. Gap: no SDK view yet builds only the visible rows of a lazy stack or grid, so the windowing is not wired into the Stack view. Tests: spare_space_is_shared_by_flexible_items_in_proportion_to_their_weight, equal_centering_keeps_the_centres_equally_far_apart, adaptive_columns_fit_as_many_minimum_cells_as_the_width_allows, a_grid_fills_rows_left_to_right, an_overlay_aligns_each_layer_to_the_anchor, view_that_fits_picks_the_first_candidate_that_fits_the_constrained_axes (springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10.rs) Refreshed 2026-10-17: covered by springboard/sdk/src/view/overlay.rs (ZStack, Grid, Columns and ViewThatFits views, re-exported from view/mod.rs); tests in springboard/sdk/src/view/tests_overlay.rs (zstack_fills_or_aligns_each_layer_in_the_same_area, view_that_fits_shows_the_first_candidate_that_fits_and_hides_the_rest). Lazy windows are ui lazy_stack.rs.

features.feature: Layout adjustments (alignment, spacing, padding, safe area)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/layout.rs, springboard/ui/src/geometry.rs (EdgeInsets), springboard/sdk/src/view/autolayout.rs (Spec::priority, Constraints::guide, Anchor::FirstBaseline/LastBaseline), springboard/sdk/src/view/controls.rs (Align::FirstBaseline/LastBaseline, View::baselines), springboard/render/src/ui.rs (Ui::centred_baseline, image_baseline)
features.note: Insets, alignment, distribution, constraints with priorities, layout guides and hugging and compression priorities are solved headless (sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-31.rs). Built 2026-10-24: first and last text baseline alignment. View::baselines is reported by Label, Button, Switch, Segmented, Checkbox, PopUpButton, TextField and Stack; a horizontal Stack with Align::FirstBaseline or LastBaseline lines the baselines up and aligns a view without text by its bottom edge, and Auto Layout gains first_baseline()/last_baseline() anchors. Host tests: springboard/sdk/src/view/tests_controls.rs (first_baseline_alignment_lines_up_text_of_different_sizes_and_images_by_their_bottom, last_baseline_alignment_uses_the_last_line_and_a_vertical_stack_ignores_baselines), autolayout.rs (baseline_anchors_line_up_text_of_different_heights, a_view_without_text_offers_its_bottom_as_its_baseline). Gap: no custom alignment guides (alignmentGuide), multi-line text reports one line, not yet verified on Midget. REA ev_b93a5d6115e46cd5d057bd6f1baba6f5bab80712a0302d4e2fd8db9ed91a5c91.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/groupings.rs (GroupBox, ControlGroup, ControlGroupStyle, TabView), springboard/sdk/src/view/forms.rs (Form, Section), springboard/ui/src/split.rs, springboard/ui/src/tab_selection.rs
features.note: Forms with sections and split view. Built 2026-10-24: GroupBox (titled card around content), ControlGroup (automatic and navigation styles join borderless buttons on one capsule plate with dividers and equal shares, palette packs them) and a TabView view over the TabSelection model (centred tab row on a card, one page visible, click or Left/Right selects and sends the action, select/selected_id bind it to app state). Host tests in springboard/sdk/src/view/tests_groupings.rs (a_group_box_insets_its_content_below_the_title, a_control_group_joins_borderless_buttons_in_equal_shares, a_palette_group_packs_its_controls_and_a_narrow_group_shrinks_them_together, a_tab_view_shows_only_the_selected_tab_and_drops_repeated_ids, clicking_a_tab_or_arrow_keys_select_it_and_send_the_action). Gap: no ControlGroup menu or compact-menu styles, no TabSection, sidebar-adaptable or page TabView styles, no group or tab-group accessibility roles, not wired into an app and not yet verified on Midget. REA ev_82d999d9ca35bf7c060d40b88c1ea62d8270a37a9072e3299303d6f8c0aefd65 (GroupBox), ev_9abf836f62e12e7ecab6b3d336a9f72862b59ddd808a0024f73147708e31470e (ControlGroup), ev_dd0e19f2411dc509513a1656094075b4f70b1983a8ea321a107c53d698b1a8c4 (TabView).

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/scroll.rs (Scroller, offset_for_rect), springboard/ui/src/scroll_position.rs (ScrollPosition, ScrollTarget, Edge), springboard/sdk/src/view/scroll.rs (ScrollView::reveal, set_scroll_targets, position, set_position)
features.note: Scrolling with model; scroll targets work headless: offset_for_rect places a row at the leading, centre or trailing edge of the viewport, clamped to the scrollable range, and ScrollView::reveal applies it (ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-05.rs). Built 2026-10-24: a scroll position binding with per-item scroll identity. ui scroll_position::ScrollPosition models automatic, edge, point and identity positions (scrollTo id/edge/y, viewID, isPositionedByUser, minimal scroll without an anchor, top-most or bottom-most visible target after user scrolling, stable edges and rows across relayouts); ScrollView takes scroll targets, applies set_position and reports wheel, drag and fling scrolling back. Host tests: springboard/ui/src/scroll_position.rs tests, springboard/sdk/src/view/scroll.rs (the_bound_position_scrolls_to_an_identity_and_an_edge, a_position_set_before_the_first_layout_is_applied_by_it, user_scrolling_updates_the_bound_position, a_relayout_keeps_the_bottom_edge_of_a_growing_document_in_view). Physics tests: ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs. Gap: vertical only, targets come from the app rather than the view tree, programmatic scrolls jump without animation, not yet verified on Midget. REA ev_c3f2fc904288ef066a11d9985a43fb1422ee185f8672869a681b629037434f56.

Style protocols beyond buttons (ToggleStyle, LabelStyle, PickerStyle, GroupBoxStyle, custom ControlGroupStyle bodies); ButtonStyle is built in sdk view/button_style.rs
Layout protocol (custom Layout types). Lazy grid views (LazyVGrid) have no SDK view: the window model is in ui lazy_stack only
